ctx.x: It is Sunday afternoon, the 6th of June, 1982, about 20 minutes of three. And we're gonna continue talking with Benny Waters for the Jazz Oral History Project, archived at the Institute of Jazz Studies, Rutgers University in Newark. And my name is Phil Schaap.
